content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on 24th August 2026 for Economics, Political Science, and History, and on 25th August 2026 for Urdu and English posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor posts at MANUU?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post-Graduate degree in the concerned subject with 55% marks, B.Ed with 55% marks, and NET/SLET/Ph.D. in Education or the concerned subject, along with knowledge of Urdu.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the MANUU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor at MANUU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Assistant Professor positions across various subjects.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this MANUU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the MANUU located?
faq.answer: Maulana Azad National Urdu University is located in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age limit relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age limits or relaxations. Please refer to the detailed notification for this information.

faq.question: Q10. Which subjects have vacancies for Assistant Professor at MANUU?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available for Assistant Professor in Economics, Political Science, History, Urdu, and English.
